title: Luxaire Furnace Code 1 Blink: Ignition Failure
meaning: One blink indicates the furnace failed to light during the ignition trial.
whenToCallPro: Ignition failures need ignitor or gas valve service.
snippetAnswer: Luxaire furnace code 1 Blink means One blink indicates the furnace failed to light during the ignition trial. Most often from failed ignitor. You can check basics first; professional repairs typically run $150–$450.

title: Luxaire Furnace Code 2 Blinks: Pressure Switch Open
meaning: Two blinks mean the pressure switch did not close.
whenToCallPro: Replace switch or inducer if needed.
snippetAnswer: Luxaire furnace code 2 Blinks means Two blinks mean the pressure switch did not close. Most often from blocked vent. You can check basics first; professional repairs typically run $175–$900.

title: Luxaire Furnace Code 3 Blinks: Limit Switch Open
meaning: Three blinks signal the high-limit switch opened.
whenToCallPro: Repeated trips need limit or blower service.
snippetAnswer: Luxaire furnace code 3 Blinks means Three blinks signal the high-limit switch opened. Most often from dirty filter. You can check basics first; professional repairs typically run $150–$600.

title: Luxaire Furnace Code 4 Blinks: Rollout Switch Open
meaning: Four blinks indicate the rollout switch tripped.
dangerNote: If you smell gas, leave the area and call a technician.
snippetAnswer: Luxaire furnace code 4 Blinks means Four blinks indicate the rollout switch tripped. This is an emergency — do not attempt DIY repairs. Call a licensed technician immediately; typical repairs run $500–$3500.

title: Luxaire Furnace Code 5 Blinks: Flame Sense Failure
meaning: Five blinks mean flame was not proven after ignition.
whenToCallPro: Replace sensor or ignitor if fault persists.
snippetAnswer: Luxaire furnace code 5 Blinks means Five blinks mean flame was not proven after ignition. Most often from dirty flame sensor. You can check basics first; professional repairs typically run $100–$450.

title: Luxaire Furnace Code 6 Blinks: Gas Valve Fault
meaning: Six blinks indicate a gas valve circuit problem.
whenToCallPro: Gas valve faults need licensed repair.
dangerNote: If you smell gas, leave the house and call your gas utility before anything else.
snippetAnswer: Luxaire furnace code 6 Blinks means Six blinks indicate a gas valve circuit problem. This is an emergency — do not attempt DIY repairs. Call a licensed technician immediately; typical repairs run $350–$900.

title: Luxaire Furnace Code 7 Blinks: Blower Motor Fault
meaning: Seven blinks signal a blower motor error.
whenToCallPro: Blower motor replacement is usually required.
snippetAnswer: Luxaire furnace code 7 Blinks means Seven blinks signal a blower motor error. Most often from failed blower. You can check basics first; professional repairs typically run $450–$1200.

title: Luxaire Furnace Code 8 Blinks: Inducer Motor Fault
meaning: Eight blinks indicate the inducer did not start.
whenToCallPro: Inducer replacement if motor will not run.
snippetAnswer: Luxaire furnace code 8 Blinks means Eight blinks indicate the inducer did not start. Most often from seized inducer. You can check basics first; professional repairs typically run $400–$900.

title: Luxaire Furnace Code 9 Blinks: Control Board Fault
meaning: Nine blinks mean the control board detected an internal fault.
snippetAnswer: Luxaire furnace code 9 Blinks means Nine blinks mean the control board detected an internal fault. Most often from surge damage. You can check basics first; professional repairs typically run $300–$800.

title: Luxaire Furnace Code 10 Blinks: Low Flame Signal
meaning: Ten blinks indicate weak flame current during operation.
whenToCallPro: Gas pressure and venting should be checked.
snippetAnswer: Luxaire furnace code 10 Blinks means Ten blinks indicate weak flame current during operation. Most often from dirty sensor. You can check basics first; professional repairs typically run $100–$400.

title: Luxaire Furnace Code 11 Blinks: Reverse Polarity
meaning: Eleven blinks suggest reversed line/neutral wiring.
diySteps: Do not operate until wiring is verified.
whenToCallPro: Have wiring corrected by a qualified technician.
snippetAnswer: Luxaire furnace code 11 Blinks means Eleven blinks suggest reversed line/neutral wiring. Most often from reversed disconnect wiring. You can check basics first; professional repairs typically run $150–$350.

title: Luxaire Furnace Code 12 Blinks: Condensate Blockage
meaning: Twelve blinks indicate a condensate drainage fault on high-efficiency models.
whenToCallPro: Replace pump or switch if drainage is clear.
snippetAnswer: Luxaire furnace code 12 Blinks means Twelve blinks indicate a condensate drainage fault on high-efficiency models. Often caused by clogged trap. Usually safe to try basic checks yourself; professional repairs run $150–$450.

title: Luxaire Furnace Code 13 Blinks: External Lockout
meaning: Thirteen blinks mean an external safety opened the circuit.
snippetAnswer: Luxaire furnace code 13 Blinks means Thirteen blinks mean an external safety opened the circuit. Most often from tripped limit. You can check basics first; professional repairs typically run $150–$600.

title: Luxaire Furnace Code 14 Blinks: Thermostat Fault
meaning: Fourteen blinks indicate a thermostat signal problem.
whenToCallPro: Wiring service if stat is calling but code remains.
snippetAnswer: Luxaire furnace code 14 Blinks means Fourteen blinks indicate a thermostat signal problem. Often caused by stat off or in cool. Usually safe to try basic checks yourself; professional repairs run $100–$350.

title: Luxaire Furnace Code 15 Blinks: Ignitor Circuit Fault
meaning: Fifteen blinks mean the ignitor circuit failed a check.
whenToCallPro: Replace ignitor or call for board service.
snippetAnswer: Luxaire furnace code 15 Blinks means Fifteen blinks mean the ignitor circuit failed a check. Most often from cracked ignitor. You can check basics first; professional repairs typically run $150–$450.

title: Luxaire Furnace Code 16 Blinks: Flame Lost During Run
meaning: Sixteen blinks indicate flame was lost while heating.
whenToCallPro: Flame loss during run needs professional inspection.
snippetAnswer: Luxaire furnace code 16 Blinks means Sixteen blinks indicate flame was lost while heating. Most often from dirty sensor. You can check basics first; professional repairs typically run $100–$3500.
